accused_gender.quote: Amar Singh, S/o Likhi Chand and Shiv Charan, S/o Pooran Chand were giving hockey blows
accused_gender.reason: The accused are described as sons ('S/o') and as 'boys', so the judgment indicates male accused.

accused_victim_relationship.correct_value: Alleged prior enmity (defence said the victim was accused of murdering Inderjeet Singh's father); PW-1 said he knew the accused from before. The Court did not rule on the enmity.
accused_victim_relationship.quote: since the victim was accused of murdering the father of the appellant, the brothers of the deceased victim had clear motive to falsely implicate
accused_victim_relationship.reason: The enmity claim is correct, but the Court never expressly rejected it, so 'did not accept this' is unsupported.

post_offence_conduct.correct_value: As noted by the Court: the accused fled the spot; disclosure statements led to recovery of the knife and hockey sticks (prosecution case).
post_offence_conduct.quote: Thereafter all of them ran towards Bhisham Pitamah Marg
post_offence_conduct.reason: The judgment notes the accused fled and made disclosure statements leading to recoveries, so 'Not stated' is wrong.

defence_argument.correct_value: Incident inherently improbable; PW-1's conduct unnatural making his presence doubtful; two other eyewitnesses hostile; conviction on uncorroborated sole eyewitness unsafe.
defence_argument.quote: conviction and sentence of the appellants based upon the sole testimony of one eye witness ... is highly unsafe without corroboration
defence_argument.reason: The knife-tip and false-implication motive points were High Court contentions, not the Supreme Court arguments recorded in para 11.
